content.rendered: You will not want to miss our school carnival on Friday, May 29th!!!  Our carnival is a fun night for everyone.  The night will be  filled with games, inflatables, face painting, fun food and more! Save the date for Friday, May 29th 4:00 pm – 8:00 pm and we will see you there!
